verdict.rationale: Decagon documents its own Insights & Reporting product, with customizable visual heatmaps for spotting spikes or dips in "key metrics" and conversational Ask AI analysis, so a first-party reporting surface exists. None of the specific metrics the story names (resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, cost per resolution) are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented resolution-rate, CSAT, handoff/escalation-rate and cost-per-resolution metrics, exec-ready dashboard views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team

citations.quote: Customizable visual heatmaps... Quickly identify spikes or dips in key metrics.
Ask AI powers deeper analysis through flexible, conversational queries.
